mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is causally linked to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals a broad-based demand contraction, which is causally linked to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 500000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (indicated by a decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weak demand for new homes, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL above 250) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as persistent inflation pressures prompt central bank tightening and equity market repricing.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 108.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.2%) signals an imminent recession, which is causally linked to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0 and UNRATE > 4.2, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 108.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
